summary: Model achieves solid overall accuracy (68.01%) with good discrimination (AUC: 0.7327) and excellent underdog performance at high confidence (top 10% ROI: 1.21), but suffers from extremely low betting volume (only 17 bets) and too many low-importance features (19 with importance < 5). The model is too conservative in identifying edges and includes significant feature noise. Key priorities: lower edge threshold to increase bet volume, prune near-zero importance features, and expand the successful high-confidence underdog strategy to capture more of the +250_plus opportunities that show 0.92 ROI.
